channel.description: Latest articles from Place North West (placenorthwest.co.uk)

item.title: Manchester tips post-fire Hotspur Press proposals for consent
item.description: Developer Manner is hopeful of making a start on site this year and could be well on its way to doing so if the city council votes in line with officer recommendation to approve plans for a 35-storey tower with 619 student flats next week. The post Manchester tips post-fire Hotspur Press proposals for consent appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Connecting the North: How UKREiiF is accelerating regional investment and long-term regeneration
item.description: As the UK works to rebalance its economic geography, unlocking investment in Northern towns and cities has become more critical than ever, writes James Bywood of UKREiiF. The post Connecting the North: How UKREiiF is accelerating regional investment and long-term regeneration appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Go-ahead for £98m redevelopment of Preston’s St John’s
item.description: The city council has given Praxis Real Estate the green light to deliver a hat-trick of apartment blocks offering up to 500 homes on the site of the city centre shopping complex. The post Go-ahead for £98m redevelopment of Preston’s St John’s appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Arora family pulls trigger on Strangeways apartments plan
item.description: Having owned the site on the corner of Dutton Street and Robert Street in Manchester since 2008, the billionaire family behind B&M Bargains has decided the time is right to progress its redevelopment into a residential scheme comprising 189 flats. The post Arora family pulls trigger on Strangeways apartments plan appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Caldwell assets up for grabs
item.description: Administrator PKF Littlejohn Advisory has tasked Watling Real Estate with selling the civils contractor’s 6,000 sq ft Warrington office, along with holdings in Stoke-on-Trent. The post Caldwell assets up for grabs appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Manchester gives green light to almost 300 Wythenshawe social homes
item.description: Muse and Wythenshawe Community Housing Group have been granted permission for the first two residential projects within the £500m regeneration of the civic centre. The post Manchester gives green light to almost 300 Wythenshawe social homes appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Habiko lodges Warrington town centre plans
item.description: The affordable homes-focused partnership between Pension Insurance Corporation, Muse and Homes England has submitted proposals for 240 homes across two six-storey buildings off Academy Way. The post Habiko lodges Warrington town centre plans appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Wrecking ball readied for Virgin’s former Manchester HQ
item.description: The 124,000 sq ft Concord House in Wythenshawe, empty after the telecoms firm relocated staff to a new office in Manchester city centre, is to be demolished to pave the way for the site’s redevelopment into an industrial complex. The post Wrecking ball readied for Virgin’s former Manchester HQ appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Consultation starts for £6m Frodsham Leisure Centre upgrades
item.description: Ellis Williams Architects is leading the design of Cheshire West and Chester Council’s 24,300 sq ft community, library, and fitness space off Princeway. The post Consultation starts for £6m Frodsham Leisure Centre upgrades appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: Aviva, Place Capital selected for Moston regen
item.description: Manchester City Council has appointed a joint venture between the investor and the developer to deliver 145 homes in the Manchester neighbourhood. The post Aviva, Place Capital selected for Moston regen appeared first on Place North West.
